research_notes: Name: PT Sumber Alfaria Trijaya Tbk (brand Alfamart); AR2025 'Identitas Perusahaan' (printed p. 40): no name change since incorporation (22 Feb 1989). Listed 15 Jan 2009. Ultimate parent PT Perdana Mulia Fajar (Djoko Susanto); PT Sigmantara Alfindo held 50.36% of outstanding shares at end-2025 (FS2025 Note 16).

Currency/units: IDR reporter; audited FS printed in Rp juta, stored as IDR billion (/1,000). Consolidated group includes the listed subsidiary PT Midi Utama Indonesia Tbk (MIDI, 77.09%; Alfamidi, Lawson), PT Sumber Indah Lestari (Dan+Dan, 65%), Alfamart Retail Asia Pte Ltd (100%) and others (FS2025 Note 1c); equity_attr excludes the non-controlling interests (Rp1,361,567 juta at end-2025).

Source policy: every FY figure is from that year's own audited consolidated FS as originally reported (EY - Purwantono, Sungkoro & Surja). FS2022 restated FY2021 and the 1 Jan 2021 balance sheet for the PSAK 24 attribution-of-benefits change (DSAK IAI press release Apr 2022; FS2022 Note 2r, PDF p. 53, and Note 34): e.g. FY2021 profit attributable 1,950,991 -> 1,925,874, EPS 46.98 -> 46.38, equity attributable 8,790,746 -> 9,223,300 juta; 31 Dec 2020 equity attributable 7,422,104 -> 7,792,526. Restated values are given in the notes of the affected datums. No other restatement found (FS2023-FS2025 comparatives equal the originals).

Fetching: alfamart.co.id answers this server (and WebFetch) with a Google reCAPTCHA challenge page; no challenge was attempted. All alfamart.co.id documents were taken from Internet Archive raw captures (id_). Since about mid-June 2026 the Archive itself only holds challenge pages for the site. idx.co.id is behind Cloudflare; www.idx.id was NOT used (not approved). KSEI dividend notices were downloaded directly from web.ksei.co.id.

Interim: the latest retrievable official period is Q1 2026 (31 Mar 2026). The H1 2026 FS exists on the company site (report-lists/July2026/rX8KWxlJWDZU2KXH9dIX.pdf) but the only Archive capture (19 Oct 2026) is a reCAPTCHA page, and no IDX copy is archived; news (Kontan, Bisnis.com 6 Aug 2026, Katadata) reports H1 2026 profit attributable of about Rp2.02 tn (+7.5% YoY) - cross-check only, not stored. No 9M 2026 report was found. Reviewer: replace the interim block with H1/9M 2026 when an official copy becomes reachable.

EBITDA: reported in every AR's financial highlights (Rp juta) and in the decks (IDR bn), never defined. AR2022 re-presented 2020 (4,582,977 -> 4,853,194) and 2021 (5,967,802 -> 5,924,392); stored values are each year's own AR. FY2025 9,063,659 from the truncated AR2025 copy = 9,064 in the 1Q26 deck.

Debt: total_debt = bank loans + bonds. Bonds: Obligasi Berkelanjutan I Tahap II Seri B (Rp400 bn, matured 8 May 2020), II Tahap I (Rp1 tn, matured 23 May 2020) and II Tahap II (Rp1 tn, matured 12 Apr 2021); none since. Excluded and stated in the notes: PSAK 73 lease liabilities (large for a store network, about Rp1.9-2.0 tn in 2024-2025), the Rp1 tn zero-coupon loan from Greatest Venture Ltd (JD.com group; carried at 647,048 / 722,380 juta at end-2019/2020; repaid 2021) and vehicle consumer-financing payables. The company's own 'interest-bearing debt' ratios (AR2020 PDF p. 112) use the same bank+bond scope. AMRT was almost debt-free 2023-2024; 2025 bank debt is a Rp760 bn Mandiri term loan.

Capex = 'Perolehan aset tetap' only. Retail-specific: 'Perolehan aset hak guna' (up-front store rent capitalised as right-of-use assets) is a further Rp1.5-2.3 tn a year (amount in each capex note) and is NOT in capex; free cash flow on the site is therefore before store-rent prepayments.

Corporate actions 2019-01-01 to 2026-11-04: none of the tracked types (no split, reverse split, bonus or rights issue). Share listing chronology (AR2020 PDF p. 75, AR2021 PDF p. 72, AR2025 printed p. 81): IPO 2009, non-preemptive issues 2012/2014/2015, 1:10 split 27 Jun 2013; 41,524,501,700 shares issued since June 2015. The EGMS of 6 May 2021 approved a rights issue (PMHMETD) of up to 5,000,000,000 new shares (EGMS minutes, https://alfamart.co.id/storage/rups-agenda/May2021/8sT2diatnMBpPIzR54bK.pdf; disclosure https://alfamart.co.id/storage/bid-prospectus/March2021/PDTjhk2u2Bx1I9iJk9SF.pdf) but it was never implemented (AR2021 PDF p. 135: 'Tidak diimplementasikan pada tahun 2021'; share count unchanged through 2026). corporate_actions is therefore an empty list and fy.2019.year_end_price is not needed.

Share buyback (not a split; shares_out is net of treasury shares): programme announced 5 Dec 2025 (disclosure https://alfamart.co.id/storage/bid-prospectus/December2025/8murlz3eUDZAdnHvVxyn.pdf), up to Rp1.5 tn / 650,000,000 shares, 8 Dec 2025 - 6 Mar 2026; 146,161,300 shares bought by 31 Dec 2025 (Rp279,629 juta) and 432,669,000 in total (Rp812,464 juta) per the 1Q26 FS Note 16 and AR2025 printed p. 13. FY2025 EPS (82.16) uses weighted-average shares, so EPS x year-end shares is 0.3% below profit.

Dividends: one final cash dividend per year FY2021-FY2025; FY2020 had an interim (Rp6.03, Dec 2020) plus a final (Rp9.30). DPS and schedules from the AGMS summaries (FY2023 and FY2024 summaries are scanned notary letters, read from page renders) and confirmed by the KSEI notices (web.ksei.co.id AMRT_DIV_<recording date>_ID.pdf). The ARs label the recording date as 'payment date' for FY2020 (21 May 2021); the AGMS/KSEI payment date (4 Jun 2021) is stored. FY2024 and FY2025 payout ratios come from news (no retrievable company document prints them) and agree with the company amounts. After the period covered here: an interim dividend for FY2026 of Rp14.50/share (about Rp595.8 bn, cum 13 Oct 2026, paid 27 Oct 2026) was reported by Bisnis.com (5 Oct 2026) - not stored (outside FY2020-FY2025).

Year-end prices: Q4 closing prices from each AR's share table (2020 800, 2021 1,215, 2022 2,650, 2023 2,930, 2024 2,850, 2025 1,975). The FY2025 AR is only available as a truncated Archive copy (5,242,880 of 14,113,328 bytes, linearized, no page tree); its first ~80 printed pages were read by decompressing the content streams (scripts/build_amrt.py ar25_text()); the dividend table (printed p. 120) and the audited FS are not in the surviving part.
Operating data (not stored): 21,120 stores at end-2025 (15,322 company-owned + 5,798 franchise, FS2025 Note 1a, PDF p. 23).
